Severe cramping pain with a bloated belly, repeated vomiting and no bowel movement for three days can mean a blocked bowel, which needs urgent imaging and hospital treatment. Do not eat or drink on the way. Have someone drive you, or call 911 if pain becomes constant and severe, you faint, or you vomit blood.
